name: LegalMatterBudgetTracker
tagline: Matter budgets by UTBMS phase and task, month-end accruals and outside counsel variance – in one Power Apps component.
description: A complete legal operations app for in-house legal teams and law firms: approve outside counsel budgets per matter and UTBMS code against an approval limit, track billed, accrued and estimate-to-complete amounts, run the month-end accrual worksheet and see variance by phase, firm and matter. Works in canvas apps, model-driven apps and Power Pages.
features: UTBMS L/P/C/E codes with phase roll-up
Approval limit and variance explanation rules
Month-end accrual worksheet with roll forward
Power Fx outputs and six events
